## Problem

What problem would this feature solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or change you would like to see.

## Use Case

Explain how this feature would be useful.

## Proposed Implementation

If you have an idea about how this could be implemented, describe it here.

Include relevant:

- Components
- Modules
- APIs
- Data structures
- Routes
- Documentation

## Alternatives Considered

What alternative solutions or workarounds have you considered?

## Affected Area

- [ ] Portfolio
- [ ] Components
- [ ] Documentation / MDX
- [ ] Theia
- [ ] GitHub integration
- [ ] LLM / AI
- [ ] Developer experience
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Other

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, examples, references, or other context if useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions.
- [ ] This feature fits the project's scope.
- [ ] I have explained the problem this solves.
